security_spec.violation_condition: Kernel interrupt controller code (e.g., AIA/ACLIC driver, KVM IRQ injection path) saves/restores or initializes mvip/mvien CSRs under the assumption they are read-only zero (the Smaiae guarantee), but the hardware now implements full Smaia where these virtual interrupt pending/enable registers are writable and functional, causing stale or uninitialized interrupt filtering state
security_spec.summary: Smaiae removal lifts the read-only-zero guarantee on virtual interrupt CSRs (mvip/mvien); kernel must now context-switch and initialize these CSRs to prevent stale interrupt masks from silently dropping or reordering interrupts on Smaia hardware
